claims.statement: The DTV has three official categories: Workcation, Thai Soft Power, and Dependent (spouse and unmarried children under 20).
Thai language schools were removed from qualifying DTV Soft Power activities in 2025; applicants for Thai language study are directed to the Non-Immigrant ED visa.
Freelancers and self-employed applicants face higher rejection rates on Workcation when portfolios or client proof are vague or unseasoned.
Since 31 August 2026, applicants must apply through the Thai embassy covering their country of nationality or legal residence and provide a criminal record certificate.
